experiment: E-01, donor-only engine validation of the two free donor candidates at fixed geometry

disposition.note: terminal for the attempt as run; no converged quantum-chemistry result exists, every chemistry-dependent result remains INDETERMINATE, the cause of the abort is undiagnosed and the activated donor remains blocked and unrun

summary: The precursor stopped at its first SCF job, P-RKS-core, when Psi4 aborted during conventional (PK) integral setup with PSIO_ERROR 17 (Incorrect block start address) on unit 92; no SCF iteration was printed. No converged electronic energy or gradient of either donor was produced, and every dependent criterion is INDETERMINATE. The activated donor was not run. The cause of the abort has not been diagnosed. A source-level postmortem and a bounded, read-only static survey of the installed build identified no cause, no exact executable diagnostic could be specified from the evidence obtained, and the attempt is closed as technically BLOCKED and scientifically INDETERMINATE.
derivation: Values are transcribed without change from the private run records named in 'sources', each identified by SHA256. Engine output and error text are published in results/e01/raw/ with the redactions stated in provenance/EXPORT-MANIFEST.md. The 'disposition', 'closeout' and 'hypotheses' fields and the revised 'proposed_next_steps' summarize the private postmortem, survey and closure records named at the end of 'sources'; they are paraphrased rather than transcribed and are set out in results/e01/postmortem.md.

hypotheses.status: ranked; none was tested by an executable diagnostic; no cause is asserted
ranked: a block or entry inconsistency in the shared conventional PK / PSIO integral input/output path, covering operand formation and overflow, entry state, submission order, relative addresses that are not normalized, and arithmetic

a filesystem, capacity or operating-system I/O condition; the inspected v1.11 source does not support it as a direct raiser of code 17, because failed operating-system writes, reads and seeks raise codes 12, 11 and 10 there, each with a distinct message, provided the installed build matches the source and the error output was emitted and captured in full; an indirect contribution is neither shown nor excluded, and disk capacity is neither established nor excluded
a workload-dependent trigger such as the size of the precursor's integral workload; it overlaps the first hypothesis rather than competing with it; nothing isolates the failure to this species

source_level_pathway.basis: Psi4 v1.11 source text, with line locators recorded in the private postmortem records; source-conditional: it does not establish the code of the installed binary, and a type declared in the source is not a measured width in the installed build
source_level_pathway.description: when the pre-striping zero-fill runs twice on one key, the second call restarts at entry-relative zero instead of extending the entry, which is left shorter than the workload by the remainder; a subsequent bucket write beginning strictly beyond the entry's current end fails the write-path block-start check and raises code 17 without an explanatory message
conditions_all_required: the pre-clamp divisor, nine tenths of the engine's memory value as used before the later clamp, is positive
the row count is positive, which is so exactly when the workload size is greater than or equal to the pre-clamp divisor (inclusive, not strict)
the remainder is positive, that is, the pre-clamp divisor does not divide the workload size; a separate condition that does not follow from the previous one
for at least one bucket, the start is not covered by the pre-striped extent as it stands when that bucket's first write is issued
source_level_pathway.row_count_zero: only the unconditional second call runs, the entry receives the full workload size and there is no shortfall
source_level_pathway.complementary_rule: a write beginning no later than the current end can lengthen the entry only when the end it requests is past the current end and the routine's last-entry condition allows it; where another entry follows, such a write raises the block-end code 18 instead, and in the remaining cases it lengthens nothing; coverage alone decides nothing
source_level_pathway.ordering: one worker thread runs jobs in submission order, so submission order rather than concurrent completion matters; this narrows the ordering question but does not remove ordering as a factor
source_level_pathway.address_normalization: a sufficient condition, not an equivalence: the global address routine applies at most one page-length subtraction, so the result is normalized when the offset sum is below twice the page length with no unsigned overflow; normalized inputs are one way to meet this but not the only way; the result is not normalized when the offset sum reaches twice the page length; both sums are unsigned and wrap on overflow
source_level_pathway.status: possible in the source text but not shown to have occurred; not established as the cause of E-01; one concrete branch inside the first hypothesis, with nothing establishing that it rather than another branch operated; neither established nor excluded
source_level_pathway.configured_memory: 2,000,000,000 bytes, recorded in the retained configuration and engine banner
source_level_pathway.not_reconstructible: the internal PK memory operand after any engine-side adjustment, the workload size, the divisor, the row count, the remainder, the extent of each bucket and the order in which the buckets' first writes were issued

closeout.exact_executable_diagnostic: not specifiable from the evidence obtained: the installed widths and so the numeric test constants, the write call and its payload, the standalone setup sequence and callability are unresolved; this is a statement about the current evidence and does not assert that a diagnostic is impossible

guard_only_replay.reason: a replay through the exported low-level PSIO::write would exercise only the exported block-start guard and would not test the installed AIOHandler restart-versus-append behaviour, which is the mechanism at issue, so it could not discriminate that mechanism

closeout.fixed_position_test_limits: a fixed-position test could not identify the cause of E-01 or weaken the capacity hypothesis by itself, and a result that did not reproduce the error would not clear the pathway unless the uncovered bucket start (condition 4) were independently demonstrated for E-01
closeout.activity: no diagnostic harness was built, linked, loaded or executed at any point, and no chemistry, engine run or calculation was performed at any point in the postmortem, the survey or the closeout
